question: Explain the nature of electric field lines of an electric dipole without drawing a diagram. Why do these field lines show a curved pattern?

options.A: The lines start from the negative charge and end on the positive charge; they are straight because the charges are equal
options.B: The lines form closed loops around the dipole because the net charge of the dipole is zero
options.C: The lines are parallel everywhere because the dipole field is uniform
options.D: The lines start from the positive charge and end on the negative charge; they are curved because the net field direction changes from point to point due to vector addition
